title: Governance, Training and Assurance
summary: The governance that makes terrorist and proliferation financing controls work: policies, accountability, staff awareness, management information and independent testing that can be evidenced to the board and supervisors.
contentGaps: Written as part of a programme: Aim and Purpose is the module's one-line description; audience, prior knowledge and core reading come from the programme

sections.Aim and Purpose: The governance that makes terrorist and proliferation financing controls work: policies, accountability, staff awareness, management information and independent testing that can be evidenced to the board and supervisors.
Learning Objectives: Allocate accountability for these risks across the three lines of defence
Specify management information and testing that show controls work
Evidence the framework to the board and supervisors
Syllabus: Policy, procedures and senior management accountability
Targeted training for front-line, operations and screening staff
Screening and monitoring testing, quality assurance and internal audit
Board reporting and what supervisors expect to see
Intended Audience: MLROs, compliance officers and financial crime analysts in investment, fund, payment, crypto-asset and fintech firms
Sanctions and screening teams responsible for customer, investor and payment screening
Senior managers and risk owners for products, corridors or customer segments with terrorist or proliferation financing exposure
sections.Useful Prior Knowledge and Experience: Some experience of AML/CFT compliance or sanctions screening is helpful. No prior specialist knowledge of terrorist or proliferation financing is required.
Core Reading: FATF, International Standards on Combating Money Laundering and the Financing of Terrorism and Proliferation: The FATF Recommendations (as updated)
FATF, Terrorist Financing Risk Assessment Guidance (2019)
FATF, Guidance on Proliferation Financing Risk Assessment and Mitigation (2021)
FATF, Best Practices on Combating the Abuse of Non-Profit Organisations (2023)
